notes.content:
- Fixed sound glitch when destroying the second boss.

- Small improvements and minor bug fixes...

notes.title: Rangok Skies Update V 1.01
notes.content:
What is new in Rangok Skies v1.01:


Practice mode: now you can play your level of choice on practice mode.

INSANE mode: Clear all trophies to unlock INSANE mode. Also added a trophy for one credit clear INSANE mode.

Last boss fight double phase: Added an extra phase to the last boss for more fun and challenge.

New features and bug fixes:
- Added windowed/full screen mode.
- Quick restart.
- Fixed input lag and other problems with some controllers on some systems.
- Some improvements and minor game play tuning.
- Bug fixes...


Please update to version 1.01! It would be much appreciated if you could report any bug or problem for it to be quickly fixed. Also please don't forget to leave a positive review if you like Rangok Skies!

Thanks.
